marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF964B Cordless High Torque Impact Wrench features a POWERSTATE Brushless Motor, providing a 200 ft-lb fastening torque and 225 ft-lb breakaway torque. With a 0-3600 IPM impact rate and four speed settings, this tool is designed for demanding applications. Its compact 8-43 in overall length and ergonomic design make it suitable for a variety of tasks.
